beats.text: In the USA, 64.1% of government expenses go to subsidies and transfers. In Saudi Arabia, 11.3%.
The USA spends 5.7 times what Saudi Arabia spends on subsidies and transfers.
Czech Republic is the world's highest, spending 83.9% of expenses on transfers.
Germany joins them near the top at 80.1%.
Near the bottom, DR Congo dedicates 10.7%.
How much of your budget goes to subsidies and transfers?
